source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Stress-test the current fantasy visual semantics by rendering the agent-selected wyvern plus hydra pair in a complex photorealistic scene, using the attached portrait only as visible appearance guidance for an original adult fictional woman.
subject: One original adult fictional woman field biologist, with visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair guided by the attached portrait, one complete wyvern, and one separate complete hydra.
setting: A volcanic plateau observatory above fumaroles at cold dawn.
event: The field biologist records a landing wyvern and a grounded hydra simultaneously so both creatures' distinct topologies can be compared at one scale.
visual_priorities: The wyvern must show one continuous body whose exactly two shoulder wings occupy the forelimb positions, plus exactly two weight-bearing hind legs and one full tail.
The hydra must show one grounded torso feeding at least three separately rooted necks and distinct heads, rather than a bundle of detached serpents.
The attached portrait controls visible facial appearance, dark wavy hair, and restrained makeup balance only; the subject remains an original adult fictional woman.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy field-biologist photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. At a volcanic plateau observatory above steaming fumaroles, she stands beside a calibrated range pole and records two separate creatures in one wide frame. A complete wyvern lands on a basalt ledge with one continuous body: exactly two membrane wings attach at the shoulders and occupy the forelimb positions, exactly two weight-bearing hind legs descend from the pelvis, and one uncropped tail balances the landing. Farther downslope, one grounded hydra has a single shared torso and belly supporting at least three clearly separate neck roots; each long neck remains distinct to a visible head. Keep the two creatures spatially separated and at readable scale, with her tablet, range pole, contact shadows, and displaced ash anchoring the survey action. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a crisp wide documentary composition that keeps her face readable while showing the full topology of both creatures.
